name: @unctad-ai/eregulations-mcp-server

tools.name: listProcedures
tools.description:
List all administrative procedures available in the connected eRegulations instance.

This tool returns the full catalogue of procedures (flattened from the nested
menu structure), each with its numeric ID. It is the usual starting point: use
the returned IDs with getProcedureDetails or getProcedureStep. It does NOT take
a search term — use searchProcedures to filter by keyword.

Returns:
  - A human-readable text list (name, [ONLINE] marker, ID, description).
  - structuredContent: {
      proceduresCount: number,
      procedures: [{ id: number, name: string, isOnline?: boolean, parentName?: string }]
    }

tools.name: getProcedureDetails
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific procedure by its numeric ID.

Returns the procedure's description, online availability and a step-by-step
breakdown (institutions, requirements, costs and timeframes summarised in the
text view). Obtain a valid procedureId from listProcedures or searchProcedures
first.

Args:
  - procedureId (number): ID of the procedure to retrieve.

Returns:
  - A human-readable text summary of the procedure and its steps.
  - structuredContent: {
      id, name, isOnline, description?, additionalInfo?,
      steps: [{ id?, name?, isOnline?, entityName? }]
    }

Errors:
  - Returns an error result if the ID is unknown; call listProcedures to find valid IDs.

procedureId.description: ID of the procedure to retrieve

tools.name: getProcedureStep
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a single step within a procedure.

Returns the institution in charge, contact details, requirements, outputs,
costs and timeframes for one step. Obtain procedureId from listProcedures /
searchProcedures and stepId from getProcedureDetails.

Args:
  - procedureId (number): ID of the procedure that contains the step.
  - stepId (number): ID of the step within that procedure.

Returns:
  - A human-readable text summary of the step.
  - structuredContent: {
      id?, name?, procedureId?, isOnline?, entityName?, onlineUrl?,
      requirementCount?, requirements?: string[], costCount?, hasCosts?
    }

stepId.description: ID of the step within the procedure

tools.name: searchProcedures
tools.description:
Search for procedures by keyword or phrase.

The search uses OR logic between words in the keyword phrase, so a single,
specific keyword usually gives the best results. Results are filtered down to
actual procedures (entries that link to a procedure). Use listProcedures
instead to browse the full catalogue.

Args:
  - keyword (string): The keyword or phrase to search for.

Returns:
  - A human-readable text list of matching procedures with their IDs.
  - structuredContent: {
      resultsCount: number,
      results: [{ id: number, name: string, description?: string }]
    }

keyword.description: The keyword or phrase to search for procedures. Sent to the eRegulations Objectives/Search endpoint.
